name: Novation Circuit Rhythm
description: Eight-track sampling groovebox with a 32-pad grid and USB / DIN MIDI.

documentation.title: Novation Circuit Rhythm Programmer's Reference v5: per-part CC and project control

abilities: Per-track sample selection, playback and slice controls over CC
Per-track sample start, length, pitch, filters, envelopes and mixer CCs
notice: Eight sample tracks default to MIDI channels 1-8. Connect USB MIDI or the 5-pin MIDI ports. Hold Shift and press Save for Setup View to configure channels and independently enable note, CC, program-change and clock transmission/receive. Channel 16 is reserved for project selection. Pad notes and encoder behavior depend on the current view and configuration; this profile supplies setup guidance and an unbound physical surface, with no guessed CC or pad maps. USB port aliases have not been verified; select this profile manually. Diagrams are original schematics with illustrative positions, not scaled hardware drawings. Remote CC controls use factory track channels 1-8. Pitch is constrained to the sampler table range 4-124; number of slices is 1-16, playback mode 0-2 and reverse/choke/slice use 0/1, not 127. Pan uses a 7-bit MIDI byte representing the documented bipolar parameter. Remap channels if changed on the hardware. NRPN effect/dipper settings and SysEx transfer are not represented as single CCs. Project program change on channel 16 uses 0-63 for immediate and 64-127 for queued selection; no project-changing button is supplied in this performance subset.
